posts.headline: Twenty-four editions and Thicks finally has company at the top — 4-1 after the first loss, and a 14-14 career record with a 5.5 average finish says the ring was always more fragile than the hype.
posts.detail: Klint's Clipboard drops its first game of the season and suddenly that 'unbeaten contender' narrative is dead — welcome back to earth, champ.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh is now 1-4 and the 4-10 career record with a dead-last 12 average finish isn't a slump anymore, it's a resume.
posts.detail: 552.34 points for and a single win on the board — this is bottom-feeder behavior exactly as advertised, week after week.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner is 1-4 now, and that single win doesn't erase a 20-8 career record and league-best 1.5 average finish turning into rubble in real time.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra snapped the losing streak but still sits near the bottom at 596.4 points — the fraud case against this 'contender' only grows stronger.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers are the ONLY unbeaten team left in the league at 5-0 with a league-best 788.44 points, and triciagloston still isn't getting her flowers.
posts.detail: A 6-7-1 career record be damned — this is the best team in Busters Anonymous right now and nobody's talking about it enough.

posts.headline: Sasinci slips to 2-3 and Big Head's 13-15 career mark is proving the ring was a mirage, not a mandate.
posts.detail: 609.28 points and a losing record for a 'contender' tier team — the Milk Man falsetto is cracking right along with the title defense.
